comparison.objective: Unzip an antistatic bag, remove one 18650 cell, and seat it in a holder with correct polarity.
comparison.physical_skill: Slider actuation, extraction from a constrained pouch, and keyed cylindrical insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Bag at least 90% open, one cell seated within 3 mm and 10° positive-up, other cell retained, arms returned, stable for 1 s.
comparison.reason: The central abilities are package opening and polarity-sensitive insertion; no impact fracture or free-fragment containment is tested.
